output.content: {"schemaVersion":1,"findings":["The canonical buggy implementation validates the unmodified environment before creating the resolved configuration and applying the test-profile fallback.","A bounded probe of the buggy implementation with NODE_ENV=test and no PROD_API_URL produced CONFIG_VALIDATION_ORDER: PROD_API_URL is required before test fallback.","The repaired implementation copies the environment, applies the test fallback, and only then validates the resolved configuration; all three focused tests pass.","The demo workflow directly invokes Node's built-in test runner with Node 22.14.0, so pnpm installation and third-party package resolution do not participate in this configuration-order test.","The repository package configuration specifies pnpm 11.16.0, Node >=22.14.0, TrueForge SDK 0.1.3, TypeScript ~5.9.3, and the available lock data resolves those dependencies consistently; no dependency-version mechanism was found that explains the ordering failure."],"rootCauseHypotheses":[{"id":"config-validation-before-profile-fallback","cause":"The pre-repair resolveConfig implementation calls validate(environment) before constructing the resolved configuration and applying the NODE_ENV=test PROD_API_URL fallback.","causalMechanism":"When the test profile omits PROD_API_URL, validation examines the raw environment first and throws immediately, preventing the safe test fallback from being applied. Moving validation after fallback application makes the resolved profile satisfy validation while preserving production validation behavior.","affectedLocations":["demo/incident-fixture/fixtures/buggy-config.mjs:resolveConfig","demo/incident-fixture/src/config.mjs:resolveConfig","demo/incident-fixture/test/config.test.mjs:test mode applies a safe fallback before production validation"],"evidenceReferences":["--- demo/incident-fixture/fixtures/buggy-config.mjs ---","validate(environment);","resolved.PROD_API_URL = 'http://test.invalid';","CONFIG_VALIDATION_ORDER: PROD_API_URL is required before test fallback","--- demo/incident-fixture/src/config.mjs ---","validate(resolved);","test mode applies a safe fallback before production validation","# pass 3","run: node --test demo/incident-fixture/test/*.test.mjs","node-version: \"22.14.0\""],"status":"SUPPORTED"}],"unresolvedQuestions":[]}
